name: file_stat
title: File Information
description: Returns size, timestamps and mode for a path without reading content. Use before edits or transfers.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Absolute path on the selected client.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

size_bytes.description: Size of the filesystem entry in bytes.

mode.description: Requested mode the result refers to.

is_directory.description: Whether the path is a directory.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
